Turkey Salad Bowl
Serves 1
Ingredients
0.13 cup
jarred mild salsa
1 teaspoon
extra virgin olive oil
1/4 pound
93% ground turkey
1/4 teaspoon
garlic powder
0.13 teaspoon
chili powder
0.13
small onion, minced
1 ounce
canned tomato sauce, 1/2 can
2.50 cup
chopped romaine lettuce
As required
optional greek yogurt or sour cream
Directions
Brown the turkey with the spices and onion, then add the tomato sauce.
Serve over the lettuce with salsa.
